title_en: Campus Traffic Control for the 80th Anniversary KBS Open Concert
summary: Everyone who drives or parks on campus should note the traffic controls in place for the 80th Anniversary KBS Open Concert. Parking and, at certain times, vehicle access are not allowed in three areas between October 8 (Thu) 21:00 and October 14 (Wed) 23:59. See the attached detailed map for the exact controlled areas.
applies_to: Everyone who drives, parks or travels by vehicle on campus. The notice does not limit this to any program or group of students.

dates.what: No parking and no passage at the parking lot on the side road by the main sports field
No parking at the temporary parking lot by the stream at the main gate
No parking on the road from Main Gate Payment Booth B to the three-way intersection in front of the College of Business (near G9)
No passage for general vehicles on the road from Main Gate Payment Booth B to the three-way intersection in front of the College of Business (near G9); route buses run normally

conditions: Parking and passage are both not allowed at the parking lot on the side road by the main sports field during the control period.
Parking is not allowed at the temporary parking lot by the stream at the main gate during the control period.
Parking is not allowed on the road from Main Gate Payment Booth B to the three-way intersection in front of the College of Business (near G9) from October 11 21:00 to October 13 23:59.
General vehicles may not use the road from Main Gate Payment Booth B to the three-way intersection in front of the College of Business (near G9) on October 13 from 21:30 to 22:30.
Route buses will run normally during the October 13 road closure.
steps: Read the attached detailed map of the controlled areas, (붙임) 교통 통제 상세 안내도.pdf; its content was not read for this translation.
Do not park or leave a vehicle in the controlled areas during the stated periods, and plan another route or means of travel where needed.
translation:
Notice of Traffic Control for the "80th Anniversary KBS Open Concert"

To ensure the safe running of the "80th Anniversary KBS Open Concert" event, traffic on campus will be controlled as shown below. Please take note.

No. 1 | Controlled area: Parking lot on the side road by the main sports field | Control period: October 8 (Thu) 21:00 to October 14 (Wed) 23:59 | Remarks: No parking and no passage

No. 2 | Controlled area: Temporary parking lot by the stream at the main gate | Control period: October 8 (Thu) 21:00 to October 14 (Wed) 23:59 | Remarks: No parking

No. 3 | Controlled area: From Main Gate Payment Booth B to the three-way intersection in front of the College of Business (near G9) | Control period: October 11 (Sun) 21:00 to October 13 (Tue) 23:59 | Remarks: No parking
Control period: October 13 (Tue) 21:30 to 22:30 | Remarks: No passage for general vehicles; route buses run normally

※ For details of the controlled areas, see the attachment.

Attachment: Detailed map of the controlled areas, 1 copy. End.

Attached file (1): (붙임) 교통 통제 상세 안내도.pdf (143 KB) (Detailed traffic control map; its content was not read for this translation.)
